analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 65.2 enters overbought territory, confirming uptrend continuation from 45.8 five days ago. MACD histogram improved from -0.1811 to 0.4775, strengthening bullish momentum. Five consecutive positive candlesticks, with a cumulative +4.2% gain over the last five trading days. Positioned at 89.0% of the 52-week high ($101.19), indicating room for further upside.
